An '''unidentified Dark Side Adept''' with pale [[Color/Legends|green]] skin was known to have lived in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at some point in history. A typical [[Dark side adept/Legends|adept]] of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], that individual sought to gain power by exploiting the inferiors and the non&ndash;[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]].<ref name="DSSB" />

==Behind the scenes==
That unidentified character appeared in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] guide ''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]'' as a generic archetype of Dark Side Adept. Since generic characters were made suitable for any era, no chronological background was given to the Dark Side Adept.<ref name="DSSB" />

The Adept's picture originated as a concept art for the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] during the pre-production of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], when actor [[Samuel L. Jackson]] had not yet been cast in the role. The Concept Artist [[Iain McCaig]] based the face of his proto-Windu on that of [[Steve Aplin]], an [[Industrial Light & Magic|ILM]] modeler, and the costume was the product of scribbling.<ref name="ATPM">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace]]''</ref>
